purpose: Teach: 緑化/痙攣/嘔吐/度数/積分/水蒸気/骨髄/流暢

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病院敷地の緑化計画を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, the hospital's going to move forward with a greening project as a medical team initiative.
lines.style: Clear, direct statement of fact. Warm but professional. Even pace, steady eye contact. The tone of someone sharing information without fanfare.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、てんかん患者の痙攣対応を医療チームで研修します
lines.en: Yes, we'll be conducting training on seizure response for epilepsy patients across the medical team.
lines.style: Measured and reassuring. Slight emphasis on the commitment to training. Unhurried, as if laying out something important but not alarming.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、術後の嘔吐対策を医療チームで丁寧に行います
lines.en: Ren, we handle post-operative nausea management with careful attention across the entire medical team.
lines.style: Steady, precise. The word 'careful' carries quiet confidence. No rushing. The tone of someone who takes thoroughness seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 視力度数の測定を、貴院、子供にもおこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does conduct vision and refraction testing for children as well, correct, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine question, not challenge. Slight pause before speaking as if turning thought into words. Respectful but engaged, not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬剤投与量を積分計算で医療チームが算出します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team calculates medication dosages using integral calculus to ensure precision.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact precision. Light stress on 'integral calculus' — not showing off, just being specific about the method. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、加湿器の水蒸気量を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes, we manage humidity levels in the hospital environment carefully as a team.
lines.style: Simple, direct. No elaboration needed. The tone of someone describing standard professional practice without overselling it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 骨髄バンク登録を、貴院、推進されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital's quite active in promoting bone marrow donor registration, aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Warm observation, genuine interest. Slight lift at the end — a real question, not rhetorical. The curiosity of someone who notices and respects what an institution does.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者への流暢な説明を医療チームで心がけます
lines.en: Yes, we make it a priority for the medical team to explain things clearly and fluently to our patients.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Slight warmth on 'clearly and fluently.' Even pace, as if this is something the doctor genuinely values and wants to emphasize.
